# Leaflet 1.9.4

Vendored browser distribution from https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/
and license from https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/LICENSE.

Upstream: https://leafletjs.com/ and https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.
See LICENSE for the BSD 2-Clause license and attribution.

GoRide uses custom `L.divIcon` markers; default marker image assets are not used.
Map tiles are provided separately by OpenStreetMap, with visible attribution.
